GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Helps users find and reschedule flights using hardcoded demo flight data, tier status, and booking policies.

templateVersions.content:
The user has requested the following flight: {!$Input:New_Flight_Requested}
Customer Information: - Membership Tier: Gold - Previous Reservation Type: Premium Economy
Available Flights (SEA to JFK):
Flight 1388: Departs 1:15 PM, Arrives 9:35 PM, Nonstop, 5h 20m Economy: $0, Premium Economy: $0, Business: $15, First: $36
Flight 2104: Departs 4:45 PM, Arrives 1:05 AM+1, Nonstop, 5h 20m Economy: $0, Premium Economy: $0, Business: $25, First: $45
Flight 3909: Departs 10:30 PM, Arrives 6:50 AM+1, Nonstop, 5h 20m (Fastest) Economy: $0, Premium Economy: $0, Business: $15, First: $36
Booking Policies: - Gold tier members may rebook at no additional charge for same-day flights. - Premium Economy fare bookings allow free rebooking up to 24 hours before departure. - Economy fare bookings have a $75 change fee. - All rebookings are subject to fare difference.
Instructions: 1. Confirm the user is eligible to rebook based on their tier and fare type using the policies above. 2. Present the available flight options with pricing. 3. If the user is not eligible, explain why based on the policies.
